curriculum: The English-taught full-time Circular Engineering BSc is 180 EC. The current official document is titled 2026–2027, dated August 2026, and differs substantively from the published 2025–26 version. Articles 1.1 and 8.4 still state 2025–26. The example uses the currently titled document and its current Appendix, corroborated by the programme page, without asserting a corrected legal effective date. Year 1 has 40 EC of courses, 10 EC of skills and 10 EC of projects. Year 2 has 40 EC elective courses, 10 EC elective skills and 10 EC of design projects. Year 3 has 5 EC ethics, 25 EC concentration courses, 5 EC concentration skills and 25 EC thesis. Circular Chemical Engineering is first in the published order.
progression: Year 2 study has two five-credit courses and one 2.5 EC skill in each of periods 1, 2, 4 and 5, with 5 EC design projects in periods 3 and 6. The eight named examples and four skills appear in the published periods and are subject to annual availability and academic advice. Article 3.8 describes a linked skills requirement, but the Appendix labels Heat & Mass Transfer, a 5 EC course, as linked to Circular Chemical Engineering and does not mark the paired skill as satisfying it. The case illustrates the published slots without certifying an approved elective combination. Year 2 exam entry requires 45 first-year EC. Year 3 exams require 60 first-year and 40 second-year EC. The independent 25 EC thesis requires those credits and 120 EC overall.
